layers.定位层_locator: target PID/name -> CR3: (1) explicit CR3, (2) physical EPROCESS scan with manual/registry ranges, (3) kernel-VA reader + ActiveProcessLinks walk (KKYUM), (4) KPRL l1malwarebits CR3-by-PID IOCTL 0x239584, (5) Invary Sensor kernel-VA read IOCTL 0x9C402408 + ActiveProcessLinks, (6) --locate --auto tries KPRL -> Invary -> KKYUM -> physical scan
layers.翻译层_translator: CR3 + VA -> PA via x64 4-level page tables (4KB/2MB/1GB pages)
layers.取数层_fetcher: PA + size -> bytes via pluggable mb_phys_reader providers

interfaces.mb_phys_reader: read(pa, buf, size) pluggable physical reader
interfaces.mb_layer_locate_cr3_kernel: kernel VA reader + system EPROCESS + list walk -> cr3 (no physical reader)
interfaces.kprl_locate_cr3: KPRL l1malwarebits IOCTL 0x239584 -> CR3 by PID (no physical reader)
interfaces.invary_locate_cr3: Invary Sensor IOCTL 0x9C402408 kernel-VA read + process list walk -> CR3 (no physical reader)
interfaces.invary_kread: Invary Sensor kernel-VA byte read (--invary-read diagnostic mode)
interfaces.probe_readers: layers.exe --probe-readers opens every real fetch provider device and reports presence
interfaces.probe_locators: layers.exe --probe-locators opens KKYUM / Invary / KPRL devices and reports presence
interfaces.probe_all: layers.exe --probe-all probes readers + locators in one pass
interfaces.list_providers: layers.exe --list-providers prints the 20 known provider/device/capability rows
interfaces.dynamic_verify: scripts/dynamic_verify.ps1: optional admin service create/start + --probe-readers + --read-phys + --locate --auto, with before/after minidump BSOD guard; -DryRun safe
interfaces.hvci_status: layers.exe --hvci reports HVCI Enabled / VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable and HVCI-compatible provider guidance
interfaces.hvci_auto: layers.exe --reader hvci auto-selects aswarpot -> mrt -> cchwapi (HVCI-PASS providers)
interfaces.kkyum_read_process: layers.exe --read-process --pid --va --size: KKYUM IOCTL 0x22265C direct process VA read (HVCI-PASS driver)
interfaces.legacy_bridge: layers.exe --reader legacy --legacy-backend <id>: 24 legacy membridge backends forwarded as fetch provider (membridge --out-file temp), supports CR3+translation+PA read
interfaces.legacy_pipeline_test: scripts/test_legacy_pipeline.ps1 + test/fake_legacy_mem.c: offline synthetic EPROCESS/page tables, verifies physical-scan locator + translation + legacy fetch, including 1MB chunking
interfaces.provider_scan: layers.exe --locate --scan-providers: tries 20 fetch providers for physical EPROCESS scan; 64KB/4KB read fallback; optional legacy backend fallback
interfaces.provider_scan_bench: layers.exe --locate --scan-bench / scripts/bench_provider_scan.ps1: per-provider open/scan timing and CR3 result
interfaces.provider_scan_mock: layers.exe --locate --scan-providers --scan-mock: offline in-process provider-scan test using built-in mock EPROCESS/page tables
interfaces.install_driver: scripts/install_driver.ps1: admin sc create/start for a provider driver with HVCI 577/1275 error hints; -DryRun safe
interfaces.hvci_driver_report: scripts/hvci_check.py audits drivers/ for signature, W^X sections, known-BYOVD hints; writes evidence/hvci_driver_report.json
interfaces.driver_submission: drivers/ contains provider samples + drivers/membridgephys HVCI-compatible source; committed to GitHub
interfaces.mock_cli: layers --reader mock: built-in 4-level and 5-level page tables + data, usable by --translate-only / --read-va without any driver
interfaces.translate_only: layers --reader mock --cr3 ... --va ... --translate-only [--la57] prints PA/page without fetch
interfaces.mb_phys_ranges_from_registry: HARDWARE\RESOURCEMAP physical memory ranges -> locator scan ranges
interfaces.mb_layer_read_va: composition of translate + fetch (cr3 provided by caller)
interfaces.cchwapi_only: layers.exe --locate --cchwapi-only: CCHWApi 2.9 only; ReadControlReg(CR3) + CCHWApi physical page-table walk + EPROCESS walk, no scan
